connector.name: Kubeview
connector.registryDescription: Read-only Model Context Protocol MCP server enabling code-driven AI analysis of Kubernetes clusters.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kubeview-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mikhae1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: KUBECONFIG
env.description: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/.kube/config if unset.

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. The published package metadata still targets stdio by default.

env.name: MCP_MODE
env.description: Server mode: 'all' (default), 'code', or 'tools'. Controls which features are enabled.

env.name: MCP_KUBE_CONTEXT
env.description: Kubernetes context name to use. If unset, uses the current context from kubeconfig.

env.name: MCP_K8S_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
env.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1'). Not recommended for production.

env.name: MCP_HIDE_SENSITIVE
env.description: Enable global sensitive data masking. Set to 'true' or '1' to mask sensitive values in responses.

env.name: MCP_TIMEOUT
env.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations. If unset, uses plugin-specific defaults.

env.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
env.description: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.

env.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
env.description: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.

env.name: MCP_HTTP_PATH
env.description: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to /mcp.

env.name: MCP_HTTP_STATELESS
env.description: Disable session IDs in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' for stateless request handling.

env.name: MCP_HTTP_JSON_RESPONSE
env.description: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' to enable.

env.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode. Required when binding to 0.0.0.0 or ::.

env.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode.

env.name: MCP_DISABLE_KUBERNETES_PLUGIN
env.description: Disable Kubernetes plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

env.name: MCP_DISABLE_HELM_PLUGIN
env.description: Disable Helm plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

env.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGO_PLUGIN
env.description: Disable Argo Workflows plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.

env.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGOCD_PLUGIN
env.description: Disable Argo CD plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.
